EC1: Uncontrolled hypertension (defined as average SBP = 160 mmHg [2 readings taken at time of screening]).
EC3: Valvular Heart Disease  including those with prosthetic valve [OR], mitral stenosis [OR] (moderate [OR] to severe) [OR] or valve repair.
EC4: Excess alcohol intake (males : = 28 units/week [OR], females: = 21 units/week. One unit of alcohol = 8 oz beer, 1 oz hard liquor or 4 oz wine).
EC6: History of "Major Bleeding" at any point (defined as overt bleeding  at a critical site including intracranial [OR], intraspinal [OR], intraocular [OR], pericardial [OR], or retroperitoneal [OR]; or bleed [AND] requiring hospitalization).
EC7: Foreshortened life-expectancy [OR] or severe comorbidities precluding study follow-up period
EC9: Severe cognitive impairment (defined as score = 5 on the Short Portable Mental Status Questionnaire)
